title: Cashback entry art, plus news and target dialog fixes
summary: Very little player-facing data changed. Two new assets register the cashback event's entry button and its daily-pack tab. Client screens refine the News Center battle bars, rework how unread server news is restored, and give the LoHa target dialog its own countdown node.
highlights: Two new assets: a cashback tab on the daily pack panel and a cashback button among the main activity icons.
News Center battle reports now size each side's bar by that side's own surviving troops, using a new pre-battle troop total.
Unread server news is now restored from the chat channel on login instead of from local player preferences.
The LoHa target dialog uses a dedicated countdown node rather than reusing the Gold Heist layout.
